purpose: Fold-internal metric learning on frozen unsupervised representations. Representations (E65 correlation-logSPD 855 + E146 log-band-power 90) are never trained with identity supervision outside the fold; only a small MLP metric head is learned from enrolled fit rows (trial fraction <= 0.6).

representation.note: Per-stream task-wise z-score on outer-train fit rows, per-stream PCA fitted on the same rows, block RMS normalization, concatenation. No identity labels are used for the representation.

head.validation_block: one inner trial-fraction block held out from the fold fit rows only; chosen automatically so every enrolled subject has validation rows

augment.note: Training-only, feature-space simulation of session drift: log-normal per-band gain, per-channel gain (log-band-power stream), linear spectral tilt across bands, additive Gaussian noise, and random band-block replacement from another trial of the same subject (feature-space surrogate for a random time sub-window; cached features have no raw sub-windows).

candidates.name: e65_baseline_repro
candidates.note: E221/E222 pipeline verbatim: E65 task standardization + PCA96 + k12 prototypes, raw distance score.

freeze_rule: A candidate is frozen only if its LOSO unknown rejection > 0.90 AND its Test S2-vs-S1 separation AUC >= 0.80. Freezing means: no further hyperparameter search, report the official-gap honestly.

extra_round.rule: One extra round only. Triggered when the best learned candidate's LOSO unknown rejection is >= e65_baseline_repro + 0.05 and < 0.90 (learning helped but did not reach the LOSO target). The extra round reruns the same recipe with embed_dim=64 and identical augmentation.

selection: All hyperparameters, candidates and the extra-round rule are fixed before the run. No Test-based selection. Test is read once after all folds and the extra-round decision are complete.
